description: One phone's credential on a Mobile Access Grant. Every per-device credential this app issues lives on one of these rows — never on the User — so there is one place to look a phone up, and revoking one handset leaves the worker's other devices working. A row starts Pending when the office shows a one-time enrolment QR, becomes Enrolled when a phone exchanges that token for its own api_key/api_secret, and ends Revoked.

fields.label: Device
fields.description: What the phone calls itself, or what the office wrote when it opened the enrolment window — 'Ana's iPhone', 'Crew truck 3'. A label for a person reading this list; nothing checks it.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Pending: a QR was shown and nobody has scanned it yet. Enrolled: a phone exchanged the QR's one-time token for its own credential, and that credential works. Revoked: it does not, and never will again — a revoked row is kept as the record, never reused.

fields.label: Device Identifier
fields.description: The stable identifier the phone reported at enrolment (the same device_id it registers for push). Recorded so two rows for one handset can be told apart from two handsets.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: The public half of THIS DEVICE's credential — the part before the colon in X-FarmOps-Token. One key per device, never shared with the User record or with another phone, so revoking this row ends this phone and nothing else.

fields.label: API Secret
fields.description: Encrypted at rest in Frappe's password store. It exists in plaintext exactly once — in the enroll_device response the phone received — and nothing in this app returns it again.

fields.label: Enrollment Token Hash
fields.description: SHA-256 of the one-time token the QR carried, NOT the token. The token itself is a bearer credential for the enrolment window; storing its hash means somebody who can read this row still cannot enrol a phone with it. Cleared the moment the token is exchanged, so it can be used once.

fields.label: Enrolment Window Closes
fields.description: After this the QR is refused, whether or not anybody scanned it. 24 hours by default.

fields.label: Last Seen
fields.description: The last time this credential authenticated a request, stamped at most once an hour. The idle sweep reads it per device, so a phone lost in an orchard is revoked on its own while the worker's new phone keeps working.

fields.label: Issued By
fields.description: Who opened the enrolment window, or who minted the credential directly.

fields.label: Revocation Reason
fields.description: Why this one device stopped working. 'Phone lost', 'replaced by a new card', 'idle 30 days' — the grant's own reason is about the person; this is about the handset.

name: Mobile Device Enrollment
